description: Paid ($0.001/call): End-of-day US equity quote: last close, day range, consolidated volume, previous close and the change between them. US equities only; indices, FX and crypto are not covered (crypto-price serves those). Built from the official consolidated end-of-day summary across all US exchanges and ATSs, so price, range and volume are market totals.

symbol.description: US equity ticker, e.g. AAPL. Indices, FX and crypto are not covered.
